annotations.title: Text to speech with subtitles: one MP3 plus SRT or VTT timed to the voice

description: Text to speech that comes with subtitles: up to 2,000 characters spoken as one MP3 in English or Spanish (Deepgram Aura-2, pick a voice), plus SRT or VTT captions whose timings come from the generated audio itself, sentence by sentence. Ready for a video editor, no transcription step. Use for narrated videos, social clips, e-learning and accessible audio with captions. Price $0.08/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
